purpose: Emergency research snapshot; NOT public operational clearance.

claims.claim: A major earthquake struck western Colombia on 2026-08-10, with reporting placing the epicenter near San José del Palmar, Chocó.

sources.name: Associated Press
sources.note: Reports a 7.4 event and states Colombia's Geological Service reported it as the country's strongest recorded in the 21st century.

sources.name: El País América Colombia
sources.note: Reports the event, date, magnitude and location based on preliminary SGC information.

claims.verification_note: The existence of the disaster is no longer treated as an unconfirmed event. Multiple independent reports document it and attribute the seismic information to the SGC. The exact status of each dynamic consequence remains separate.

claims.claim: Search-and-rescue operations are continuing, while the reported number of missing people is changing across successive updates.
claims.verification_note: The continuation of rescue activity is corroborated. Fatality and missing-person numbers must remain timestamped and independently tracked; they must not be merged across update times.

source_audit: The earlier snapshot incorrectly treated the existence of the disaster as pending primary-source confirmation. This has been corrected. Absence of a directly retrieved SGC page is not evidence that the disaster did not occur.
